name: line-personal-mcp
description: Read, search and answer your personal LINE chats — E2EE messages and media decrypted locally.
long_description:
Unofficial MCP server for your personal LINE account. It logs in as a companion device (your phone stays logged in): after installing, ask Claude to **log you in to LINE** and scan the QR code it shows with LINE on your phone.

Read and search chats (Thai/Japanese friendly), view end-to-end-encrypted photos, see who read your messages, get new messages in real time, and — only with your approval — reply, react, send files and unsend.

Everything runs on your computer; the only network traffic is to LINE. **Requires Node.js 18+.** Unofficial and not affiliated with LY Corporation — use at your own risk.

local_store.title: Keep a local message store
local_store.description: Store messages on this computer (~/.line-mcp/messages.db, private) for instant search, new-message alerts and waiting for replies.

max_sends_per_min.title: Max outgoing actions per minute
max_sends_per_min.description: Safety cap on sends, reactions and unsends.

node_path.title: Node.js binary (optional)
node_path.description: Only if Node.js isn't found automatically (Homebrew, /usr/local/bin, nvm, volta, fnm are detected).
